description: Source code for the GraphingNumPad class in a calculator app, handling UI interactions, button actions, and trig function visibility.

classes.name: GraphingNumPad
classes.description: UI class for the graphing calculator's numeric keypad, managing button presses, visibility toggles, and math input.

methods.name: GraphingNumPad
methods.description: Constructor initializing UI components and setting button labels based on localization.

methods.name: ShiftButton_Check
methods.description: Handles shift button check event, toggling operator row visibility.

methods.name: ShiftButton_Uncheck
methods.description: Handles shift button uncheck event, resetting UI and button states.

methods.name: TrigFlyoutShift_Toggle
methods.description: Toggles trig function row visibility based on shift state.

methods.name: TrigFlyoutHyp_Toggle
methods.description: Toggles hyperbolic trig function row visibility.

methods.name: FlyoutButton_Clicked
methods.description: Resets trig and hyp buttons and hides related flyouts.

methods.name: ShiftButton_IsEnabledChanged
methods.description: Updates operator row visibility when shift button enabled state changes.

methods.name: SetOperatorRowVisibility
methods.description: Sets visibility of operator and inverse operator rows based on shift button state.

methods.name: SetTrigRowVisibility
methods.description: Sets visibility of trig function rows based on shift and hyp button states.

methods.name: Button_Clicked
methods.description: Handles numeric and function button clicks, inserting corresponding text into math editor.

methods.name: BackSpaceButton_Clicked
methods.description: Deletes the last character in the math editor.

methods.name: GraphingNumPad_PointerPressed
methods.description: Handles pointer press to prevent focus movement.

methods.name: GetActiveRichEdit
methods.description: Retrieves the currently focused math rich edit control.

methods.name: Flyout_Opening
methods.description: Sets flyout show mode to transient when opening.
